logo-source.png: Use case: logo-brand. Create final primary logo source artwork for TubeScribe using ONLY Option 3 (rightmost panel) of the supplied reference comparison. The reference is design direction, not an edit canvas: isolate and refine that one design into ONE large square badge centered with modest clear transparent margins. Preserve forest-green rounded-square badge, double contrasting cream and dark-green border, cream vintage movie reel on the left, amber circular hub containing a cream play triangle, a cream ribbon of film merging into a small stack of saved transcript pages on the right. Three bold ink/green transcript strokes. Above elements occupy upper two thirds; exact readable wordmark 'TubeScribe' across bottom, large warm cream bold geometric sans serif. Maintain memorable symbolic scene, tasteful subtle dimensional print shading and clean contours, no gratuitous glossy effects or photorealism. The reel has generous holes and pages are simple distinct shapes, reference recognizable and consistent. Forest green #21644e / deeper forest, warm cream, amber #9b5c00. The badge carries its own green background, surrounding canvas MUST be genuinely transparent alpha, no white rectangle or checkerboard. Cream/dark outline ensures contrast on white, off-white, GitHub dark and transparent backgrounds. Exact text TubeScribe only, no headings, option labels, small lettering, watermark, additional logos or anything from other panels. Square composition, all edges and wordmark comfortably within boundary.
icon-source.png: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final text-free app icon and favicon SOURCE derived from supplied TubeScribe primary logo, which is the identity reference. Create one square, clean simple icon. Preserve the forest-green rounded-square tile with cream inner keyline and dark outer edge, warm cream vintage video reel left, amber circular play button hub, cream film ribbon becoming a stack of TWO transcript pages right. Simplify aggressively for legibility at 16, 32 and 48 pixels: fewer larger reel apertures, flat bold forms, TWO broad green strokes on the foremost page, thick bold edges, minimal gentle dimensional shading. Make the reel/pages scene fill the tile and balance it centrally, removing the entire wordmark area. No wordmark, no text of any kind, no letters, no initials, no monograms, no typographic glyphs, no headings, no watermark. A geometric play triangle and abstract transcript strokes are allowed. Strong simple silhouette related closely to reference. Colors dark forest green #21644e/deeper green, warm cream, amber #9b5c00. Surrounding canvas genuinely transparent alpha, modest even transparent margin, no white square or baked checkerboard. Badge has its own solid green background and contrast-safe cream inner keyline so it works on white, off-white, black and transparent layouts. Avoid hairline details, extra objects and unnecessary texture.
